notes.title: Demo Update 1.1.0
Avante! Atlantis working on Steam Deck Update and Info!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone, Danilo here.


There was an issue with a plugin we were using (the one we animated the Commanders!) so for the time being, I've removed the animation for them 😦


but

Now we have a version that works with SteamDeck! (and/or Proton).
(and soon we will have a native Linux version as well)

Our animator is already hard working on re-doing the animations in a new software, so wait for an update soon!



On other news:

Story Mode (Prologue) is in development! And will be available on the demo;

New Gallery updates;

And introducing the 5th Commander: Omar "Pink Scarab" Wahid (Check the gallery for more info!)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/57c55dc1757795f2d6cbedd1a3fb3e8ff0a88cae.png"]



Thanks, and Avante!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.0.7 - Let's get wet!
Demo Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Danilo here, creator of Avante! Atlantis



First of all, I'd like to thank everyone who played the demo, for all the feedback and love sent.
I've been developing Avante! Atlantis solo for about 1 year now. When I mean solo, I mean I do 90% of the project, while the others 10% I have help from friends and freelancers, so I want to publicly thank all the people who have helped me:

Luiz Carlos de Gino for stylized Character Designs;

Leo Ross for helping with Character Emotions (Not yet in game!)

Roberta B. Giorgi for the cute Nation Emblems Logos;

Guilherme Nogueira de Sá for helping me with Character Profiles and Story;

Andreas Karnung for the awesome Music;

Thami Nakamura for the wiggly Characters Animations;

Karol Orttiz for Amara and Reiko placeholder voices; (Not yet in game!)

And everyone else on our discord! Love you guys ːsteamhappyː


I'm closely reading everything and every feedback, so please, don't hesitate in sending one! I'm all ears and I want to make a better game together with the community.



Now without further ado, here is the change list for the Demo 1.0.5


DEMO 1.0.5MAJOR UPDATES

[hr][/hr]New Commander revealed!
The youngest ever Chess Grand Master from the nation of Amethyst Tigers: Vihaan Sharma.

WHAT a kid is doing for fighting for Atlantis? Doesn't make sense! 

The battle for Atlantis is unlike any conflict the world has seen. This isn’t a war of strength - it’s a clash of brilliant minds. Only the sharpest strategists from each nation have been chosen. Here, victory belongs not to the strongest, but to the smartest.

Vihaan and the next strategists will not be available to play on the demo, but will be on the Gallery!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/d48e6f44c1d46ccb8a782ced229e6fc516a221e0.png"]


[hr][/hr]

UPDATE SETTINGS MENU
Both in the main menu and in battle!

Settings menu also have a "Apply Settings" button;

Added Cursor Sensitivity;

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/66db07ba0a128df1da5e561277ebdf01eb635da6.png"]


[hr][/hr]

NEW DICE POWER METER AND ANIMATION 
Now dice values will appear above the dice when it finishes and animate towards the base attack;

Power meter was redesigned to be more intuitive:

Red: 1/20 chance of a ±25

Orange: 1/15 chance of a ±25

Yellow: 1/10 chance of a ±25

Green: 1/6 chance of a ±25 (will shiny if you hit!)

Also the Strategists Cards on battle now have movement!


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/fe9253d4a1a286ec3a35bacb1ef3328199bcb622.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f28e58b0e34bcee884fdd3f33ece587c474c668c.png"][/carousel]

[hr][/hr]

(SIMPLE) BATTLE TUTORIAL 
Just something for now while we make the playable version


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/1c874f023ac136191e84d62f14a3f47b44de0017.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/c08ea76d81e6a880f46ca51d7c2fa72edca50d0f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/30dfdb55725f032338802ec5dbcf1d9ffb932a9f.png"][/carousel]

[hr][/hr]

UNITS AND TILE CHEAT SHEET
Based on feedback from the community;

Accessible only during battles, from the pause menu;


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/7037fa60e4c1c3290d30a89c288eb2d65b8a6dad.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/6ca47807b5521b3fe49cb692ff9bb177ba7f459d.png"][/carousel][hr][/hr]

MAPS UPDATES
Cacti Forest and Mirage on Desert;

Mirage on Desert was just a small update to make the map more dynamic;

Cacti Forest was redesigned to be smaller;
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/9db3beb61782b39f6862d5425281a9e7f636436c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45262520/f481aa17b217c80224c24eae2ba3f809cb1f6adc.png"][/carousel]

[hr][/hr]

MINOR UPDATES/FIXES
Tutorial texts can now be skipped with LMB, instead of just spacebar;

Fixed a small issue when you would kill a unit, but would receive at least 1 damage back;


[hr][/hr]

KNOWN BUGS
Settings menu can't be navigated with controllers. We are solving this issue as fast as we can;

There is a small chance of menus disappearing when changing cameras in the main menu. (forcing you to quit the game). I wasn't able to reproduce it, but if someone did and record it, would be great!


[hr][/hr]


Thanks and Avante!
